text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Yo, Trainer!
Thanks for giving me the day off!"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I got to take my time talking with Pops and the others,
and they really fired me up.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I can run in top condition,
just like a freshly serviced motorcycle!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I'll be going full throttle as usual, so I'm counting on you.
